text: City Council needs to appoint two public members to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund (TAF) Board to fill two current vacancies. The Environmental Nominating Panel will conduct the interviews at its June 13, 2018 meeting and make recommendations to City Council.

The Environmental Nominating Panel recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidate to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on May 24, 2021, and until a successor is appointed: - Karim Bardeesy 2. City Council appoint the following candidate to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on November 30, 2018 and for a subsequent four year term ending November 14, 2022, and until a successor is appointed: - Antoine Belaieff 3. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (June 13, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board.
